item.title: BC Finishes Weekend 2–2 Following Wins Over Cornell and Losses to Northwestern
item.description: Boston College baseball went 2–2 this weekend, beating Cornell twice and falling to Northwestern in the other two matchups.

item.title: After a Season Lost to Injury, Halie Pappion Is Pitching Again
item.description: After making 18 starts with a 2.88 ERA in 2024 and helping BC to its first postseason appearance in six years, Halie Pappion lost the 2025 season to injury. Now, though, the senior pitcher is healed and ready to make a comeback.

item.title: BC Closes and Cancels Monday Classes for the Second Time This Semester
item.description: For the second time in four weeks, Boston College closed and canceled classes due to a snowstorm that’s expected to bring up to a foot and a half of snow to the greater Boston area.

item.title: BC Panel Highlights Faith and Community-Based Responses to Immigration Crisis
item.description: As the country grapples with one of its most politically fraught eras, several Catholic organizations have stepped up across the United States to serve the undocumented community.

item.title: “People Find a Way”: Olayo-Méndez Discusses Keeping Faith Amid Border Tensions
item.description: Despite increased immigration tensions across the country, Rev. Alejandro Olayo-Méndez, S.J., emphasized the importance of migrants maintaining hope despite hardships.

item.title: Boston’s Role in Supporting Immigrants Highlighted at Law, Conscience, and Migration Today Series
item.description: Amid escalating immigration crackdowns across the country, the United States finds itself at a defining moment in history where individual action has never been more consequential, according to Monique Tú Nguyen.

item.title: BC Panel Tackles Migration Challenges Through Legal and Humanitarian Perspectives
item.description: Even though we are living in a historically significant time concerning immigration, American immigration policy has been complex and problematic since the country’s founding, argued Daniel Kanstroom

item.title: Seitz Discusses Catholic Response to Immigration Crisis
item.description: As the country grapples with politically fraught immigration crises, the Catholic Church offers dignity and support for immigrants, according to Rev. Mark Seitz.

item.title: BC Community Honors Intellectual Legacy of Late Ken Kersch
item.description: Scholars and students gathered in the Murray Room Friday for an all-day symposium honoring the late Ken Kersch.
